semiconductor_relevance: High — Chain Logic International Corp. provides specialized equipment and services for the semiconductor industry, including testing and measurement solutions.
summary: Chain Logic International Corp. (CLIC) is a Taiwanese company that offers high-quality equipment and parts for the semiconductor sector, focusing on advanced testing solutions and materials. Established in 1994, CLIC supports high-tech industries such as LED, LCD, and semiconductor manufacturing through localized service and technical innovation.

regional_presence.Taiwan: CLIC is headquartered in Hsinchu, Taiwan, and has established service centers in Taichung and Tainan.
